verdict.rationale: Numeral doesn't ship an embedded conversational assistant inside its own dashboard, but it does expose an official MCP server so external AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, custom LLM agents) can be delegated tasks like checking nexus status, filings, and transactions, plus 'AI product classification' as an automated feature. This satisfies the spirit of agentic delegation but not literally a 'built-in' assistant inside the product UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app chat/assistant UI, and independent confirmation of MCP delegation working hands-on.
